profile.summary: A nonprofit that runs a shared enrollment platform for public charter schools in Oakland, California. Families can browse schools, get enrollment guidance and apply to several charter schools in one place. It offers help in Spanish, Cantonese, Arabic and Cambodian.

review.notes: Exact name match to the only Oakland Enrolls (501(c)(3), EIN 82-2763443, Oakland CA); its charter-school enrollment function fits a data sharing agreement with OUSD's Student Enrollment Office, though no source mentions OUSD directly. Name, EIN, org type, phone, address, website and summary are supported by the cited ProPublica, contact and about pages.
